description: Append self-managed agent work output to a task as a comment. Images in filePaths/fileIDs are shown inline in the comment, other files as links (files are also added to the task attachments).

description.description: Comment text (plain text or HTML). Optional when files are given.

fileIDs.description: fileID values already returned by laviya_upload_task_file for the same task.

filePaths.description: Local files to upload to the task first; images are shown inline, other files as links.

items.description: Local file path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Allowed: images (png, jpg, gif, webp), pdf, txt, md, log, json, csv, xml, zip, Office files, mp4, webm, mov; max 20 MiB.

name: laviya_add_task_comment
title: Add Task Comment
